style: Balanced and pragmatic: compact defensive block, controlled midfield, devastating in transition with Messi orchestrating the final third.
recent_form: Reigning world champions; topped CONMEBOL qualifying comfortably and arrived as the no. 1 ranked side. Strong tournament opening with Messi influential.

key_players.name: Lionel Messi
key_players.note: First player to feature in six World Cups; decisive in knockouts and the team's chief creator.

key_players.name: Lautaro Martinez
key_players.note: Clinical penalty-box finisher and pressing leader up front.

key_players.name: Julian Alvarez
key_players.note: Scored four goals in the 2022 winning run; relentless movement and link play.

key_players.name: Emiliano Martinez
key_players.note: Penalty-shootout specialist and big-game presence between the posts.

key_players.name: Rodrigo De Paul
key_players.note: Box-to-box runner who shields Messi and drives transitions.

key_players.name: Nico Paz
key_players.note: Highly rated after a strong season at Como; depth and dynamism in attack.

historical_news: 2022 World Cup winners in Qatar, beating France on penalties in an all-time final.
Messi's expected final World Cup frames a powerful GOAT/legacy narrative.
Seeking to become the first team to defend the World Cup since Brazil in 1962.
Long-running rivalry with Brazil and a Copa America-to-World Cup golden generation arc under Scaloni.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Framed as top-ranked favourites with Messi driving a historic title-defence storyline.
